usedFor: Shopify holds checkouts and orders, and Kylas CRM keeps the shoppers as leads through “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create or Update Lead” in Kylas CRM
bestTemplate.why: It skips or updates when a phone or email already exists, so a repeat shopper stays one lead.

watchOut: A left cart becomes a Kylas CRM lead after a delay, since “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling.
